subject.title: [Feature] Support Anthropic advisor tool (beta server-side tool)

question: Should OpenClaw accept Anthropic-specific advisor/server-side tool support through the bundled Anthropic provider now, or defer it behind the broader native server-side tools design?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it introduces provider-beta behavior, user-facing model params, session replay semantics, and documented limitations around encrypted server-side tool results.

options.title: Refresh and review the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/64064 as the implementation candidate, resolving conflicts and deciding the encrypted-result replay tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Narrow to generic server-side tools first
options.body: Track the common block parsing and replay work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/23353 before adding the advisor-specific config wrapper.

options.title: Defer the provider-specific beta
options.body: Leave advisor support out until Anthropic's API stabilizes or a provider-neutral plugin approach is chosen.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/64064 as the implementation candidate, resolving conflicts and deciding the encrypted-result replay tradeoff before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the Anthropic transport runtime and has the strongest git-history connection to this provider path.
